### CC0 asset sources
The 3DAssets.dev map GLBs used by the web client are published as CC0 1.0 Universal by their source pages. No attribution is required by CC0; source URLs are nevertheless recorded here for provenance.

### Authorized non-open-source/original material
MECCHA CHAMELEON game files, mod-kit resources and the supplied model-resource material are retained as source-of-truth/reference material under the project authorization and are not represented as generally open-source content.

Modifications in this project include browser/Three.js adaptation, server-authoritative state integration, WebSocket protocol integration, surface sampling, paint/brush UI, pose controls, seeker abilities, camera/HUD/VFX integration, and map loading.
